hints.title: Sorted Position Coordinate Mapping
hints.text: Sort values and their original indices to observe valid transition ranges as intervals.

hints.title: Greedy Forward Jumping
hints.text: From each sorted index, find the furthest index to the right whose difference does not exceed the allowed threshold.

hints.title: Binary Lifting Reachability
hints.text: Precompute power-of-two jump tables to count the minimum steps required to reach or exceed target positions.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Binary lifting tables answer reachability queries in logarithmic steps.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Single step traversals take O(N) time per query.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Doubling jump tables store ancestors across logarithmic depth.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Sort and precompute binary lifting jump tables for fast distance queries.
